We bring 120 years of successful mission support to improve security, streamline logistics, and enhance readiness. Aligned around a shared purpose, our $4.5B company and 16,000 people work alongside our clients, here and abroad, to tackle their most complex challenges with integrity, respect, responsibility, and professionalism.

The Galley Supervisor will oversee all Food Services activities as directed by the Galley Manager. The main areas of concentration will be the oversight of the kitchen operations, food preparation, and inventory levels. The Supervisor will oversee the scheduling and training of employees. In the absence of the Galley Manager, the Galley Supervisor will be the Galley POC.
q: Education/Certifications: One year of related experience may be substituted for one year of education if a degree is required.
Must have a current US Driver’s License.
Current food service sanitation, food protection manager certification and safety training requirements such as ServSafe® Manager or other accredited program - IAW P5010 Chapter1 Section 2-1.2.2.D
All contractor chefs must have Certified Culinary Certification issued by the American Culinary Federation.
Prior military must be E-6 and above former Mess Management Specialist or Culinary Specialist rating if prior Navy or equivalent MOS for other service.
At least five years of foodservice experience in a military Food Services or cafeteria-style or multi-entrée operations providing complete meal services (breakfast, lunch, and dinner).
At least one year of experience as a food service manager or assistant manager. Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office products (i.e. PowerPoint, Word, Excel)
Must be computer literate and proficient in MS Office software.
Must be able to read and speak English.
r: Manage subcontractors with food preparation, food serving, cashier operations, cleanliness of the dining areas, serving lines, kitchens, temperature danger zones, dishwashing area, and storage areas IAW with PWS and SOPs. Ensure proper cooking techniques are being applied IAW standards and guidelines as established by NAVSUP P-486, NAVSUP P-7, The Armed Forces Recipe Service, NAVSUP P-476, Navy Food Service, NAVSUP P-580, Fat, Cholesterol and Calories List for General Messes, The New Professional Chef, and The Art and Science of Culinary Preparation. Maintain all equipment accountability and serviceability and turn-in and ordering of stock levels.
Manage scheduling and training for the sub-contractor workforce to ensure compliance with requirements IAW PWS
Direct and ensure that required procedures are followed.
Ensure that all employees are always in compliance with all established Safety Policies and Regulations.
Performs other duties and assignments as required.
Required to Supervise FN workforce for all Food Services requirements. Not responsible for any Supervisor Budgets.

d: Fives Services Gulf is actively seeking a Proposal Engineer to join its teams in Bahrain.

To independently prepare and coordinate high-quality, competitive technical and commercial proposals supporting five aluminium smelters and the Diversity team. The role requires an experienced engineer capable of managing complex proposal requirements, coordinating with internal stakeholders and clients, and addressing technical and commercial risks in high-value tenders while maintaining quality and speed across multiple concurrent opportunities.
q: Engineering degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics or a related discipline, with priority given to candidates with an electrical engineering background.

Relevant professional experience is essential, ideally 2–4 years in proposals, estimating or technical sales support, with demonstrated ability to manage technical and commercial submissions independently.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with project management tools and CAD software is a plus.
High attention to detail and ability to perform under pressure.

Able to contribute with limited day-to-day supervision, coordinate effectively with stakeholders and clients, and manage concurrent opportunities without an extended graduate training period or ongoing intensive senior support.
Willingness and ability to travel frequently across GCC and MENA for site inspections, customer meetings, and technical/commercial discussions.
Flexibility to work in industrial environments while adhering to HSEQ standards.
Commitment to maintaining confidentiality of customer data and compliance with company ethics and policies.

By becoming part of Fives, you will join an international group offering access to a wide range of growth and mobility opportunities. We provide an environment where you can learn, grow, and develop both professionally and personally.
r: Independently manage technical and commercial proposal preparation, including complex electrical aspects, for five aluminium smelters and the Diversity team under tight deadlines.
Draft, format, and edit proposal documents in alignment with client requirements and internal standards.

Coordinate effectively with Engineering, Business Development Managers (BDMs), Execution teams, Back Offices, clients, vendors and subcontractors to obtain and resolve technical and commercial inputs.
Maintain proposal trackers, bid logs, Salesforce, and document control systems to ensure accurate record-keeping.

Review client tender documents, assess electrical and other technical requirements, and identify technical and commercial risks in high-value tenders; define clarifications, assumptions and exclusions for internal review to protect the company.

Independently prepare and validate compliance matrices, bills of quantities (BOQs), estimates and cost sheets, including electrical scope, for review and approval in accordance with internal procedures.
Contribute to proposal reviews and technical/commercial discussions, coordinate outstanding actions, and escalate unresolved issues promptly.
Manage multiple concurrent opportunities, prioritising workload to maintain submission quality, completeness, compliance and competitiveness within deadlines while minimising delays and rework.
Attend site visits across Gulf countries and participate in client meetings to gather firsthand project insights.
